name: Lifting Up The Name Of Jesus
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of lifting up the name of Jesus through heartfelt prayer and praise, as seen in Psalms where lifting hands and praise are acts of worship directed to God. This lifting up is not merely physical but spiritual, inviting all who thirst to come freely and partake of the grace offered without cost, as Isaiah urges. Jesus teaches that following Him requires self-denial and commitment, symbolized by taking up the cross, which aligns with the call to genuine worship and proclamation of the gospel, even in the face of opposition as recorded in Luke.
